lighting_shading.note: Strong top-down spotlight creates a theatrical stage effect.

value_contrast.note: Good separation between the blue drums and purple background.

color_palette.note: Vibrant blue and gold contrast against the purple backdrop.

composition_hierarchy.note: Central composition with a clear, singular focal point.

shape_proportions.note: Toy-like proportions with rounded, chunky forms.

viewpoint_depth.note: Standard three-quarter view providing good spatial depth.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by lighting rather than lines.

surface_finish.note: Highly polished, plastic-like surfaces with clean reflections.

rhythm_staging.note: Repetition of cylindrical drum shapes creates visual rhythm.
